out.rationale: Leike et al. define recursive reward modeling, where A(k-1) helps the user evaluate A(k). Engels et al. group recursive reward modeling, iterated amplification and weak-to-strong generalization as sharing the goal of weaker systems overseeing stronger ones and define Nested Scalable Oversight as the iterated process in which weaker systems oversee stronger ones, which then oversee even stronger models in the next stage.
out.scope: proposed EXTENDS: iterated schemes where weaker systems oversee stronger ones in stages, abstracted into nested scalable oversight

text: The authors describe recursive reward modeling, iterated amplification, scalable oversight, weak-to-strong generalization and related methods as sharing the goal of weaker systems overseeing stronger ones, and define Nested Scalable Oversight as the iterated process in which weaker systems oversee stronger ones, which then oversee even stronger models at the next stage.
